title: Rizia/Turn 10/STRIKE SCENE/HOUSE STRIKE FAIL/Revolution Fail Branch/Revolution Fail Branch Conversation

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The heavy double doors crashed open..."
entries.dialogueText: The heavy double doors crashed open, and a group of armed men rushed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I quickly took cover. Everything ha..."
entries.dialogueText: I quickly took cover. Everything happened so fast, it was difficult to discern what was going on, but I was sure Adarfo's men had the upper hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Instead of being overwhelmed, they..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of being overwhelmed, they unleashed a hail of bullets on the attackers.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Defensive protocol -- engage! Prot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defensive protocol -- engage! Protect priority targets!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the guardians fell in the in..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the guardians fell in the initial clash, but the others responded with unrelenting efficiency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In a matter of seconds, two of the..."
entries.dialogueText: In a matter of seconds, two of the attackers dropped to the floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the assailants began to fall bac..."
entries.dialogueText: As the assailants began to fall back into the main hall, it became clear that the uprising was faltering.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Now's our chance! Close ranks and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now's our chance! Close ranks and move forward! Nobody leaves the library."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Stay where you are, Your Majesty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Stay where you are, Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In rapid succession, two more attac..."
entries.dialogueText: In rapid succession, two more attackers fell to Titus's marksmanship.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus motioned for his men to push..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus motioned for his men to push ahead into the next room, but he stayed behind, keeping a watchful eye on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He squeezed the trigger with lightn..."
entries.dialogueText: He squeezed the trigger with lightning speed, dropping the would-be shooter before a single shot could be fired.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Time was running out."
entries.dialogueText: Time was running out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "So I embraced the only option I had..."
entries.dialogueText: So I embraced the only option I had left... escape.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Realizing there was no escape, I re..."
entries.dialogueText: Realizing there was no escape, I remained where I was. I would have to confront whatever I had coming head-on.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your pathetic attempt to use viole..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your pathetic attempt to use violence to force reform has been crushed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your pathetic little rebellion has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your pathetic little rebellion has ended in failure."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Lucky for us, we caught wind of it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucky for us, we caught wind of it just in time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If you think everyone’s as corrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think everyone’s as corruptible as you... think again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The pain was blinding, and my visio..."
entries.dialogueText: The pain was blinding, and my vision blurred as consciousness slipped in and out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Golden Guard seized me by the a..."
entries.dialogueText: The Golden Guard seized me by the arms and dragged me into the adjoining room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Name your price, Titus. Whatever y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Name your price, Titus. Whatever you want -- money, power -- it’s yours. Just let me go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't have to wait long. A spray..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't have to wait long. A spray of bullets hit the ground near Titus’s feet, sending him diving for cover.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "It was now or never. I bolted past..."
entries.dialogueText: It was now or never. I bolted past Titus towards the door.
entries.menuText: Use the element of surprise and make a run for it immediately.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That was when I seized the opportun..."
entries.dialogueText: That was when I seized the opportunity and bolted for the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just as I reached the main hall, a..."
entries.dialogueText: Just as I reached the main hall, a gunshot cracked from behind. A sharp pain tore through my left side, and I crumpled to the floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked down, blood pooling around..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked down, blood pooling around my hand as I clutched the wound. Somehow, I knew it was Titus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't tell how much time had p..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't tell how much time had passed before the gunfire faded into silence. When my eyes focused again, Titus was standing over me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Congratulations, Titus. You passed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, Titus. You passed the test. Now, if you'll excuse me... I'll be going now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Take one more step, and I will res..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take one more step, and I will restrain you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Minutes seemed like hours, and befo..."
entries.dialogueText: Minutes seemed like hours, and before long, the gunfire subsided. Captain Castellanus approached Titus.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Guards, take him away.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guards, take him away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? You believe I'd cooperate wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? You believe I'd cooperate with these thugs?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By what right do you dare to arres..."
entries.dialogueText: "By what right do you dare to arrest me?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right is defined by the oath I swo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right is defined by the oath I swore -- to defend the Crown's true purpose, not the whims of a single monarch."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""By the authority vested in me, I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the authority vested in me, I hereby declare King Romus is to be taken into custody for treason against the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, seemingly always a step ahea..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, seemingly always a step ahead, reacted with calculated ferocity. As one man leveled a gun at Hugo, Titus' hand was already moving.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were being led by Adarfo."
entries.dialogueText: They were being led by Adarfo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Minutes seemed like hours, and befo..."
entries.dialogueText: Minutes seemed like hours, and before long, the gunfire subsided. Titus turned to me after receiving the "all clear" from his men.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Going for his boxing injury was the..."
entries.dialogueText: Going for his boxing injury was the obvious solution, but he was too far away to strike.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't have to wait long. A spray..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't have to wait long. A spray of bullets hit the ground near Titus’s feet, sending him running in my direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My hand brushed against a bronze pl..."
entries.dialogueText: My hand brushed against a bronze plaque that had fallen from its mount.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I grabbed it without hesitation and..."
entries.dialogueText: I grabbed it without hesitation and slammed it into Titus’s side, aiming for his kidney.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grunted in pain, clutching his s..."
entries.dialogueText: He grunted in pain, clutching his side as he doubling over as the blow landed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Coward!""
entries.dialogueText: "Coward!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't wait for him to recover. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't wait for him to recover. I scrambled to my feet and bolted for the main hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several Wruhec's Guardians seized m..."
entries.dialogueText: Several Wruhec's Guardians seized me by the arms and dragged me into the adjoining room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was escorted toward the exit,..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was escorted toward the exit, I saw Vina and Mother watching from a distance with shock written across their faces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was escorted toward the exit,..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was escorted toward the exit, I saw Mother watching from a distance with shock written across her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if this would be the las..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if this would be the last time I’d ever see them again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if this would be the las..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if this would be the last time I’d ever see her again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I found a chair and sank into it, e..."
entries.dialogueText: I found a chair and sank into it, exhausted, as the muffled clamor of the uprising continued outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned back to his men."
entries.dialogueText: He turned back to his men.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo found his way to me."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo found his way to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Having Titus nearby would prove dif..."
entries.dialogueText: Having Titus nearby would prove difficult, but not impossible.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo was nowhere to be seen."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo was nowhere to be seen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Especially since I knew his weak sp..."
entries.dialogueText: Especially since I knew his weak spot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo proudly stood, raising his a..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo proudly stood, raising his arms high.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But to my dismay, I soon came to re..."
entries.dialogueText: But to my dismay, I soon came to realize that the Golden Guard was far from the vulnerable targets I had anticipated.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your time is over, parasites!""
entries.dialogueText: "Your time is over, parasites!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo and his revolutionaries floo..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo and his revolutionaries flooded in like an unstoppable tide, and the room erupted in gunfire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One guardsman fell in the initial c..."
entries.dialogueText: One guardsman fell in the initial clash, but the others responded with unrelenting efficiency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As his revolutionaries flooded in l..."
entries.dialogueText: As his revolutionaries flooded in like an unstoppable tide, Adarfo joined the fray, and the room erupted in gunfire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But to my dismay, I soon came to re..."
entries.dialogueText: But to my dismay, I soon came to realize that the Wruhec's Guardians were far from the vulnerable targets I had anticipated.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""For the people!""
entries.dialogueText: "For the people!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Romus... tell me you didn't have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus... tell me you didn't have anything to do with this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita found her way to me."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita found her way to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no time for this. I have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no time for this. I have to make sure my mother and Vina are safe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know what you are talking..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what you are talking about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quiet, woman! I don't need your me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, woman! I don't need your meddling right now!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may not see it now, but believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not see it now, but believe me when I say that I was doing what was best for the country -- for us."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What the hell... Do you have any i..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell... Do you have any idea what you've done?! You've ruined everything!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How dare you speak to me with such..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you speak to me with such disrespect! Answer me now! Were you or were you not involved?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m sorry. I made a mistake. I nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m sorry. I made a mistake. I never meant for it to come to this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What?! Do you have any idea what y..."
entries.dialogueText: "What?! Do you have any idea what you've done? You've ruined everything!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You're lying! I can see it in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're lying! I can see it in your eyes! Your delusions have ruined our child's life..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your mother?! What about our child..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your mother?! What about our child? Admit it, Romus, you've ruined everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing, knowing full well t..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing, knowing full well there wasn't anything I could say to undo what had already transpired.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ruined? We've been heading down th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ruined? We've been heading down this path for a long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll speak to you any way I damn w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll speak to you any way I damn well please! I don't have to explain myself to you or anyone else!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I wasn’t! And I won’t stand he..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I wasn’t! And I won’t stand here and be accused of such treachery!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright! I admit it! I was behind..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright! I admit it! I was behind it from the start! I wanted to tear down the monarchy brick by brick! There. Is that what you wanted to hear?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes met Lucita’s, her expressio..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes met Lucita’s, her expression filled with scorn and hatred.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. We'll find a way out..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. We'll find a way out of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I said I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I said I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""'Sorry' isn't going to cut it. Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Sorry' isn't going to cut it. What you've done is unforgivable."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You’re naive if you think there’s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re naive if you think there’s any way out of this now."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If we’ve been heading down this pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we’ve been heading down this path, it’s because you refused to see the signs along the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned away, my gaze falling on H..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned away, my gaze falling on Hugo. His expression mirrored Lucita’s, filled with contempt.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty... tell me you didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... tell me you didn't have anything to do with this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You yourself compromised their saf..."
entries.dialogueText: "You yourself compromised their safety, didn't you? My God, Romus... You've ruined everything."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wish I could believe you didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could believe you didn't wish to bring ruin on this kingdom, Romus. I really do..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So it is true! Dear God, Romus......"
entries.dialogueText: "So it is true! Dear God, Romus... Do you have any idea what you've done? You've ruined everything!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then it's true? Dear God, Romus......"
entries.dialogueText: "Then it's true? Dear God, Romus... Do you have any idea what you've done? You've ruined everything!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may not see it now, but believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not see it now, but believe me when I say that I was doing what was best for the country -- for the family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hold your tongue, old man! I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hold your tongue, old man! I don't need your meddling right now!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""'Old man?' How dare you speak to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Old man?' How dare you speak to me with such disrespect! Answer me now! Were you or were you not involved in this upheaval?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Apologies are meaningless. What yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies are meaningless. What you've done is unforgivable."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're a fool if you think there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a fool if you think there's any way out of this now."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If we've been heading down this pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we've been heading down this path, it's because you chose to ignore the signs along the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes met Hugo's, his expression..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes met Hugo's, his expression filled with contempt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From the corner of my eye, I saw Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: From the corner of my eye, I saw Lucita and motioned for her to follow. But seeing the guards around her, I realized she was trapped. I pressed on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From the corner of my eye, I saw Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: From the corner of my eye, I saw Lucita and motioned for her to follow. But seeing the guards around her, I realized she couldn't so I pressed on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: Titus turned to me.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""All clear, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "All clear, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no time for this. I have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no time for this. I have to make sure my mother and the others are safe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to wait until Titus was d..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to wait until Titus was distracted, then make a run for it.
entries.menuText: Wait for the right moment, then run.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "It was now or never. I grabbed a br..."
entries.dialogueText: It was now or never. I grabbed a bronze plaque that had fallen from its mount and rushed at Titus, aiming for his kidney.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to wait until he came clo..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to wait until he came closer to me.
entries.menuText: Wait for him to come closer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He twisted away. The plaque connect..."
entries.dialogueText: He twisted away. The plaque connected with a spot on his side just above my intended target.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He coughed and took a few steps bac..."
entries.dialogueText: He coughed and took a few steps backwards.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Coward!""
entries.dialogueText: "Coward!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't wait for him to recover. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't wait for him to recover. I scrambled to my feet and bolted for the main atrium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I consent. Just don't hurt my fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "I consent. Just don't hurt my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You fool. Adarfo was right. The Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You fool. Adarfo was right. The Crown will crumble into insignificance, and the people will take power."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Adarfo is dead. And the monarchy w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Adarfo is dead. And the monarchy will live forever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your family had nothing to do with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your family had nothing to do with this scheme. They will live."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""SUPPRESSIVE FIRE!""
entries.dialogueText: "SUPPRESSIVE FIRE!"
